business.body:
- Describes itself as "India's only AV company with a robust service infrastructure backed by deep engineering expertise and advanced acoustics experience", claiming unmatched industry capability.
- Claims one-stop-shop status for mid/high-end AV and automation by holding distribution rights for many top AV brands (Denon, KEF, JBL, Polk) plus partnerships for Crestron, Lutron and Unilumin - a wider range than smaller integrators or single-brand dealers.
- Positions itself at the high end of both axes versus competitors: global OEMs (Samsung, Sony) sell mass products with limited custom service, niche integrators offer bespoke solutions with narrower product lines, and electronics retailers focus on commodity electronics.
- Flagship showrooms and demo experience centres with trained experts are framed as a competitive advantage against online-only sellers.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Corporate history] Incorporated in 2006 as Advanced Audio Solutions Pvt. Ltd., now PRO FX Tech Limited (CIN L51500KA2006PLC040879), headquartered in Bengaluru.
- [Leadership] Led by Mr. Manmohan Ganesh, Chairman & Managing Director, with over two decades of expertise in the audio-video and consumer electronics industry.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions PRO FX Tech as a leading Indian distributor and system integrator of premium audio-video, automation and home-theatre solutions, combining exclusive distribution rights for global brands with in-house design, installation and after-sales service.
